summary.plain: ZEPLIN-III was a 12 kg two-phase liquid xenon dark matter detector in the Boulby mine, the third and last of the ZEPLIN detectors, run from 2006 to 2011. It saw no dark matter and closed the ZEPLIN programme.
summary.technical: Two-phase xenon TPC with 12 kg of liquid xenon in the Palmer Laboratory (1070 m, 2850 m.w.e.). First science run 27 Feb - 20 May 2008 (83 days) gave a spin-independent limit of 8.1e-8 pb at 55 GeV/c^2; after an upgrade (low-background PMTs, plastic-scintillator veto) the second run (24 Jun 2010 - 7 May 2011, 319 days, 1344 kg d raw) gave 4.8e-8 pb near 50 GeV/c^2 (3.9e-8 pb combined).

technology.quote: uses a 12kg two-phase xenon time projection chamber to search for the weakly interacting massive particles (WIMPs)
technology.value: Two-phase xenon time projection chamber measuring scintillation and ionisation
